risk_note: RV2 (orders/**, union/**). Shop dimension of the source backfill (BR-ATTR-15 ③, orchestrator ruling D10-64 B): PDD order mall_id maps to UnionOrder / orders.shop_id as decimal text (invalid or missing → empty, the order still imports); Taobao / JD add no shop field (no id aligned with the goods side; shop names are not used). The first import hands the shop to the backfill; a present-but-empty shop with a known slot scene and no exact / product hit leaves the four source columns NULL instead of none; a later sync that brings the shop rematches once in the same CAS update (guarded by the source still being NULL); shop_id only goes from empty to set. No retry counter (08 has no limit; default per D10-65 / D10-70). Goods-side shop_id is still empty, so the shop tier does not hit in production yet (reported to the orchestrator).
